description: This file contains unit tests for the Azure Table Storage-based reminder service in an Orleans-based distributed system. It defines a test class with multiple test methods that verify reminder functionalities such as start, stop, restart, multi-reminder handling, and failure scenarios, using the Xunit testing framework.

classes.name: ReminderTests_AzureTable
classes.description: A test class for verifying Azure Table Storage-based reminder service in Orleans, including various operational and failure scenarios.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: A fixture class for setting up the test cluster environment.

classes.name: SiloConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans silo to use Azure Table Reminder Service with test defaults.
